correctionToTheProposedSignal.proposed: failing with MISSING_CREDENTIAL instead of the restrict error is positive evidence the list was accepted, because restrict() runs at child composition before model auth
correctionToTheProposedSignal.measured: REFUTED. Authentication precedes the child's composition in this build: with no key the run stops at MISSING_CREDENTIAL and with a dummy key it stops at `AUTH: Authentication Fails`, both at the PARENT's first model step, so mpd_role_spawn is never invoked and the restriction is never evaluated (both lanes: `restrict error present: 0`). Recording it as positive evidence would have enshrined a false positive.
correctionToTheProposedSignal.replacement: the credential-free stub lane above is the strongest live evidence this environment allows
